title: SheepDex (BSC) SpeFactory UniV3-fork — live extraction assessment
closed_reasons: Pool/factory/periphery math is logic-identical to canonical Uniswap v3-core v1.0.0 (token-level normalized diff of SwapMath/Tick/TickBitmap/Position/Oracle)
The only non-standard swap input (swapFee looked up by recipient) is an operator-set fee override (max 0.3%); setFee was never called and it cannot break the k-invariant or the IIA balance check

collectProtocol(address token) arbitrary-token sweep and setFeeProtocol are gated by onlyFactoryOperator = EOA 0x1efd11d3C814B873b6167d6AA402FDF3EB76E1ED; all setters revert for unprivileged callers (eth_call simulation + fork test test_access_gates 4/4)
LP positions (34,591 NFTs) are owned by the standard UniV3 periphery NFTPositionManager; decreaseLiquidity/collect/burn require isApprovedOrOwner

Arbitrage routes measured on a BSC fork all lose money except microscopic dust: the pools' good-token balances are dominated by protocol fees + LP accrued fees, and the tradeable in-range liquidity is razor-thin
key_facts: Factory SpeFactory 0x571521f8c16f3c4ed5f2490f19187ba7a5a3cbdf (BSC), deployed block 11641289, Solidity 0.7.6, verified source recovered
81 pools enumerated exhaustively via full PoolCreated log scan; all created 2021 (last at block 15824303); fee tiers 1000/2000/5000 with tickSpacing 20/40/100
Total live pool balances $428,442.03 at block 127099664 (DefiLlama live $426,469-$427,015) — triage figure independently confirmed
Protocol fees summed = $48,499.82 (11.3% of all value), collectible only by operator EOA 0x1efd11d3...E1ED (last tx 2024-07-30, block 40923865); director owner EOA 0xAc80034e...CA3E
LP-claimable (pools with liquidity>0) = $379,109.94 across 34,591 position NFTs held by 1,934 distinct addresses (118,443 ERC721 Transfer events reconstructed)
Stuck excess in liquidity==0 pools = $832.28 (donations); NFTPositionManager holds $0.000002 dust; its sweepToken is permissionless but empty
No custom swap fees ever set (setFee selector 0xba364c3d absent from factory history; swapFee(bot,2000)==2000)
feeProtocol initialised to 34 (2/2) in SpePool constructor (canonical 0); live pools show 34 or 85 (5/5) — protocol takes 1/2 or 1/5 of swap fees
Pools actively arbed by bots with tiny ($20-160) swaps; major pairs track market within fees; ETH/BUSD, CAKE/WBNB, ETERNAL/WBNB retain larger stale deviations but their tradeable depth is dust
All major arb routes lose money on a fork: ETH triangle -26% at 1 BUSD; ETH-vs-Pancake -20% at 100 BUSD; CAKE -99.99995% at 0.001 WBNB; ETERNAL -99.95% at 0.0005 WBNB
Best measured positive routes: SPC cross-pool +$0.0019, ALPACA cross-pool +$0.000025, micro CAKE/ETERNAL layers ~$0.0000003 each
caveats: USD values are DefiLlama-priced at block 127099664; +/- 1-2% price drift vs triage
Operator key liveness is unknowable; if the operator EOA key is lost, the $48,500 protocol fees become stuck (S)
H-O assumes the 1,934 NFT holders can transact; many positions are dust and may never be claimed
Dust arb profits do not cover gas; 'extractable' figures are net of swap fees only
The first CI run was affected by load-balanced RPC replica lag; final PoC runs use a local anvil snapshot pinned ~100 blocks back
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0.002 live (dust arbs only); the $428k of pool value splits into $379k holder-recoverable LP positions (34,591 NFTs) and $48.5k operator-only protocol fees, with canonical UniV3 math and working access control closing every other path.
